newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westgold mulls next Mt Edon move.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westgold mulls next Mt Edon move.

text.p: Westgold Resources NL, which earlier on Monday said it increased its stake in Mount Edon Gold Mines NL to 6.75 percent, would consider a takeover bid for the Western Australian gold producer, Westgold chairman Mladen Ninkov told Reuters.
"We're always looking at our options, which may include a friendly (takeover)," Ninkov said.
"We may look to an acquisition or disposal," he added.
Ninkov said he liked Mount Edon's production profile, which includes the Tarmoola, Tuckabianna and Nevoria gold mines in Western Australia.
But he said he not favour current management of Mount Edon.
Ninkov said he believed management was behind the company's current debt load of around A$30 million.
Mount Edon earlier this year said it expected to lift its output of gold by more than a third to 120,000 ounces in 1996/97 (July/June).
Mount Edon chairman Tony Brennan, when asked by Reuters to comment on Westgold's increased stake, would say only that Westgold "had a keen eye for good assets".
Mount Edon shares ended steady at A$1.60, valuing the company at A$117.62 million based on 73.51 million shares outstanding.
